summary: Strict external-agent readiness report for all 21 AI graphics tools. Callable means the agent can submit a controlled private request. Executable means the controlled adapter actually performed runtime work and returned structured private output evidence, including the mock worker-claim-to-canonical-route smoke for the 13 non-GPU tools. GPU/model tools remain blocked_with_reason until approved native CUDA, private model/input paths, and private proof refs are supplied for a scoped on-demand call. Capability-mismatch calls fail closed with failed_with_diagnostics and do not invoke adapters.

stateDefinitions.callable: The external agent can submit the controlled private route request.
stateDefinitions.executable: The controlled adapter performed bounded runtime work and produced structured private output evidence.
stateDefinitions.blocked_with_reason: The request shape is valid, but a required runtime/model/input prerequisite is absent.
stateDefinitions.failed_with_diagnostics: Execution was attempted or route validation failed and the row includes an actionable reason.

fastestGpuModelUnlockCandidate.remainsBlockedUntil: Run on an approved native Linux/amd64 NVIDIA CUDA host with the canonical proof image available and a private approved source frame mounted locally.
